court: Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

issues.label: Statute of limitations under 28 U.S.C. § 2501
issues.why: The court must determine whether the six-year limitations period bars Mr. Bee's claim and when it accrued.

issues.label: Claim accrual date for disability retirement
issues.why: Whether the claim accrued at discharge, at BCNR decision, or another triggering event affects timeliness.

issues.label: Subject matter jurisdiction under Tucker Act
issues.why: The court must confirm the disability retirement pay claim is money-mandating and within its jurisdiction.

issues.label: Continuing claim or accrual suspension doctrines
issues.why: Whether any tolling or continuing-claim theory affects the limitations analysis for retirement pay.

issues.label: Whether medical board review was required
issues.why: The failure to convene a medical review board before discharge may bear on accrual and merits.

issues.label: Correct legal standard for fitness for duty
issues.why: The court must decide whether BCNR applied the proper standard for assessing unfitness at discharge.

issues.label: Liberal consideration under 10 U.S.C. § 1552(h)
issues.why: Whether the statute required liberal consideration for PTSD/TBI claims and whether BCNR applied it.

issues.label: Effect of BCNR's silence on liberal consideration
issues.why: Whether failure to explicitly state application of liberal consideration constitutes reversible error.

issues.label: Applicability of binding military policy guidance
issues.why: Whether Kurta/Hagel-type memoranda mandating liberal consideration bind the BCNR here.

issues.label: Standard of review of BCNR decision
issues.why: Whether the decision is arbitrary, capricious, unsupported by substantial evidence, or contrary to law.

issues.label: Adequacy of BCNR's reasoning and explanation
issues.why: Whether the 2023 Decision articulated a rational connection between facts and conclusion.

issues.label: Fit for duty despite continued service as instructor
issues.why: Whether performing instructor duties supports a fitness finding notwithstanding PTSD/TBI diagnoses.

issues.label: Relevance of voluntary VSP separation
issues.why: Whether voluntary separation forecloses or affects entitlement to medical disability retirement.

issues.label: Weight of VA 100% disability rating
issues.why: Whether the post-discharge VA rating bears on the fitness-at-discharge determination and standards differences.

issues.label: Preponderance of evidence standard application
issues.why: Whether BCNR properly applied the burden and standard of proof to the fitness question.

issues.label: 30-percent disability threshold for retirement
issues.why: Whether Mr. Bee's conditions met the threshold entitling him to disability retirement versus separation.

issues.label: Scope of relief and remand versus judgment
issues.why: Whether the appropriate remedy is remand for reconsideration or judgment on the record.

issues.label: Effect of prior voluntary remand and 2019 decision
issues.why: How the superseded 2019 Decision and remand posture affect current review.

issues.label: Presumption of fitness for continued service
issues.why: Whether a rebuttable presumption of fitness applies given his retention and promotion.

issues.label: Relationship between promotion/PMOS change and fitness
issues.why: Whether removal from limited duty and promotion undermine an unfitness claim.
